verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a dedicated MTTx Analytics page that groups and visualizes incident metrics by team, service, environment, severity, user, and custom fields to show overall health. A separate Alerting Analytics page shows how events become alerts, how many are acknowledged, and how many become incidents, which covers alert and incident load. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of on-call health metrics (e.g., pages per responder, off-hours burden), explicit documentation of time-series trend views for MTTA/MTTR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
